prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied four-leaf folding-screen game selection UI according to this exact newest user feedback: colors/materials feel odd, screen characters must be LESS three-dimensional, use silhouette/reveal to show selection state, DELETE each character's selection button, improve the small head-silhouette ink seals. Preserve the overall zigzag four-leaf screen geometry and the left negative-space heading "选个搭档"; four characters remain completely INSIDE their own individual screen panels in order 泡泡/递蕉/墨墩/烘栗.
MANDATORY CHANGES:
1. Replace the dense crinkled/embossed texture with clean, subtle rice-paper fibers. Almost smooth matte paper with sparse fine grain, no scaly leather noise, no embossed wrinkles, no dirty mottling everywhere. Airy neutral ivory background, restrained mineral sage and light stone-green screen paintings, thin dark warm-grey frames, modest dull ochre accents. Avoid an overall cyan/grey muddy wash, beige-yellow cast, bright metallic gold or pitch-black screen. Clearly separate light screen background from colored figures with controlled flat color shapes. Color should be fresh and harmonious, not washed-out or gloomy.
2. Screen CONTENT is now FLAT HAND-DRAWN INK AND GOUACHE ART PRINTED ON PAPER, not a 3D sculpture, sticker, cutout or relief. No thick white outlines, no volumetric rim shading, no figure cast shadows, no heavy gradients, no feet on protruding stone platform. Fine dark ink outlines and large flat paint shapes with a tiny amount of brush variation only. The physical SCREEN frame can keep perspective, but everything painted INSIDE a leaf shares that flat plane.
3. Selection example MUST be exactly: first otter 泡泡 is SELECTED by P1 and fully revealed in color; third panda 墨墩 SELECTED by P2 and fully revealed in color. Second golden monkey 递蕉 and fourth red panda 烘栗 are NOT SELECTED, so replace their ENTIRE figures including props by clean solid muted dark-sage SINGLE-COLOR SILHOUETTES. Monkey silhouette clearly has top tuft, round ears, slender limbs and long curved tail; red panda silhouette clearly has pointed ears, wide cheeks, large curved ring-tail OUTLINE and open fan outline. Unselected figures have NO eyes, face, clothing details, stripe patterns or internal shading. All four NAMES remain readable. These silhouettes represent not-selected, NOT locked; add NO locks or question marks. Keep P1 round small marker on the first panel and P2 diamond + tiny check on third. Selected otter indigo robe/teal sash and panda muted brick-red robe/teal apron maintain characteristic design. Panda teal bow not a flower.
4. REMOVE ALL FOUR SELECT/READY RECTANGULAR BUTTONS inside the screen completely, including their frames and text "P1已选", "选择", "P2已备". Do not replace with another kind of button. Keep each character name near bottom of its leaf in quiet calligraphy and a tiny unobtrusive detail mark. Rebalance painted figures/negative space so removed buttons leave natural uncluttered paper, not four empty holes. P1/P2 panel badges and colored reveal now communicate selection.
5. Redesign BOTH small footer character HEAD SEALS cleanly. Equal-size compact stamps, no full-color faces and no irregular blob outline. The P1 OTTER head uses a low rounded oval head, small side ears and broad muzzle negative-space cut, single deep jade ink. The P2 PANDA head uses broad round head, TWO distinct round ears and two very simple negative-space eye-patch cutouts, single muted cinnabar ink. Minimal geometric/head-silhouette construction, recognizable at small size; tidy consistent stamp circle, tiny sparse edge breaks show stamped ink but 90% crisp solid coverage. No facial expression, clothing, elaborate texture or sketch shading. Make the panda seal especially clear, not an empty white bulb with dark ears. Keep them beside footer "P1 待备" and "P2 ✓", with unobtrusive separator. 
Keep the bottom-right "入坊" GLOBAL navigation control (muted/disabled because P1 not ready); only the four PER-CHARACTER select controls are removed. Keep back arrow. Do not add paragraphs, descriptions, extra numeric labels or explanatory text. Result should be an elegant light paper/ink screen selection illustration with immediately legible COLOR vs SILHOUETTE states, not a glossy rendered menu. Full-page landscape 16:9.
